g.text: Sequence Diagram - VIS01 Viewer Lifecycle (resize, reload, leaving the page / logout)
One KitchenViewer owns at most one ViewerEngine. Every path that leaves or replaces the scene
goes through ViewerEngine.dispose(), so GPU memory is released and no render loop keeps running.
The effect creates a fresh canvas after loading assets. Cleanup removes it explicitly.
1. Resize (window resized, navigation collapsed - WEB02 responsive layout)
resizes the window / toggles the navigation
the canvas fills the main content area;
header and navigation are never covered
2. Reload (viewer "Reload" / "Retry", or "Open / reload the kitchen viewer" after an activation in WEB06)
[every registered module (reverse order, each in try/catch)]
if build() is pending, the attempt signal is aborted;
the load finalizer sweeps again when the build settles
release assets still held by the effect;
scene of the CURRENT active configuration
a failed reload never brings back the
3. Leaving the viewer (another section) or logout / session ended by WEB03
[Session ended by WEB03 after a 401 of any business request]
release assets still held by the effect;
Back navigation after logout goes through the
module slot again: no scene is shown to a Guest (AA04)
